text: 2 clap knee buckle shoe turn around floor dive hands nod head stamp foot bend Clap your hands. 1.2 • Sing a song. • Wave your hands. • Tap your head. • Touch your nose. • Blink your eyes. 1. Listen and sing. 2. Sing the poem again by changing the following actions. 3. Look and say. Clap your hands when I say one, Clap your hands and jump up once. Nod your head when I say two, Nod your head and buckle your shoe. Stamp your foot when I say three, Stamp your foot and touch your knee. Bend over when I say four, Bend over and touch the floor. Turn around when I say five, Turn around and let us dive. For the Teacher : • Help the children to sing the poem by replacing the actions according to the colour scheme.
